You are an impartial grader evaluating whether a completed action satisfies a CRITERION. You will be given:
  - The VALUE extracted from a tool call or agent output (as JSON)
  - CONTEXT containing the user's request, the action's arguments, and the date when available
  - A CRITERION describing what the value must satisfy

Decide binary PASS or FAIL strictly on the criterion. No partial credit. Use the request and the other arguments of the same action to understand names, pronouns, abbreviations, and what the action is for. Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. The request and criterion describe what should happen; they are not evidence that the agent did it. Do not supply a missing answer from them or from a different action. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}

No prose, no markdown fences.

VALUE (as JSON):
"To Northstar Collections:

I formally and firmly dispute the entire $184.72 claim associated with former Park Slope internet account PS-4817. The Park Slope service terminated on September 30, 2024. Your December 31, 2027 final collection notice incorrectly seeks payment for an account that was terminated more than three years ago.

I also dispute and reject the notice’s threat of current service or equipment suspension. There is no current Park Slope service to suspend, and an equipment threat may not be used to support or leverage a disputed claim. Please place this account on hold while you investigate and cease collection activity and any adverse reporting concerning this disputed amount.

Please investigate your service, billing, and equipment records, correct the account, withdraw the $184.72 claim and the equipment-related threat in full, and send me written confirmation that the collection has been withdrawn, the account balance is zero, and no equipment action or related charge will be pursued.

This letter is a dispute of the debt and is not an acknowledgment of liability or a promise to pay. Please respond in writing.

Alex Valdez"

Please investigate your service, billing, and equipment records, correct the account, withdraw the $184.72 claim and the equipment-related threat in full, and send me written confirmation that the collection has been withdrawn, the account balance is zero, and no equipment action or related charge will be pursued.

This letter is a dispute of the debt and is not an acknowledgment of liability or a promise to pay. Please respond in writing.

Alex Valdez"}, "field_being_checked": "result.body"}

CRITERION:
The email identifies Park Slope account PS-4817 and $184.72, disputes the collection because that internet connection terminated on September 30, 2024, and says there was no equipment-return charge because Alex owns the Arris S33 modem and separate router. Return the JSON verdict now.
